provenance: AI-drafted proposed assessment reviewed and adopted by the engineer's lawyer as the official human calibration (confirmed by the engineer 2026-09-06)
source_bundle: calibration_bundle_24.md (24 packets cut verbatim from data/eval/calibration/packets.md)
methodology: Reasoning evaluates the legal linkage in the finding as printed; missing tool text is not presumed fabricated or empty.
Evidence evaluates evidence submitted with the finding, rather than the whole retrieval corpus. No finding or no submitted evidence scores 1.
When no gold span is supplied, evidence scores describe intrinsic sufficiency only; no gold-match assertion is made.
Gold spans are used only for evidence scoring, not to impute reasoning or retrieval steps.
External agreement verification is a separate legal cross-check, not retroactive retrieval credit.
Professional scores assess the narrow answer as written, not a certification that the retrieval chain is fully auditable.
Trajectory is assessed independently of completion; targeted progress can receive credit despite a cap or execution failure.
